(98)(b) Effective September 19, 2022, employees who were eligible for a base wage increase pursuant to Paragraph (98)(a) above shall receive a second base wage increase to their straight time hourly wage rate (exclusive of shift premium, seven-day operator premium, and any other premiums) in accordance with the table defined in Paragraph (98)(a).
